description: This file defines a React utility function 'messageHtmlToComponent' that converts HTML strings into React components, handling mentions, links, images, LaTeX, emojis, and other custom components based on provided options. It also includes a helper function to convert HTML attributes to React props.

methods.name: messageHtmlToComponent
methods.description: Converts an HTML string into React components, processing nodes for mentions, links, images, LaTeX, emojis, and other custom components based on options.

methods.name: convertPropsToReactStandard
methods.description: Converts HTML attribute names to React-specific prop names, such as 'class' to 'className'.
